implementation.publish_protocol: versioned Chroma collection plus atomic JSON state pointer
implementation.failure_semantics: failed build does not change current_version

tests.command: DJANGO_DB_CONFIG=config/db_config.yaml.example uv run --project . python manage.py test data_pipeline.tests.test_log_documents data_pipeline.tests.test_index_version deepseek_api.tests.test_topklogsystem deepseek_project.tests.test_configuration --noinput

published_index.embedding_dimensions_note: The persisted vectors were verified as 1024-dimensional; Ollama config does not currently declare this value, so IndexSpec preserves null until a deliberate config change and rebuild.

limitations: The published full-index fixed-set Recall/MRR is below the M4 target because the fixed set covers only the original root-level corpus and full-corpus distractors are not yet optimized
No claim of real full-corpus rebuild peak-memory measurements yet
BM25 currently scores the vector candidate set rather than an independent full-corpus index
